DUELSCATS.GMOnly: Only the Game Master can start a duel.
DUELSCATS.NoMoreTokens: All visible tokens are already assigned.
DUELSCATS.DragHint: Drag scene tokens into the Challenger / Challenged columns (or between them, or back to the list, to reassign).
DUELSCATS.OutcomeProvoque: {winner} turns the intimidation around and wins the duel!
DUELSCATS.OutcomeCombat: Neither cat backs down: the duel turns into a normal fight.
DUELSCATS.OutcomeImpressionne: Neither {provocant} nor {provoque} truly intimidates the other, but {provoque} is still somewhat impressed. It's their call what happens next.
DUELSCATS.EngageCombat: The challenged cat starts a fight
DUELSCATS.CombatStarted: Both cats were added to the combat tracker.
DUELSCATS.ReputationApplied: Reputation gain applied to the sheet.
DUELSCATS.ReputationWriteFailed: Could not write reputation to the actor sheet (check the path in the settings).
DUELSCATS.SettingsHint: Attribute paths on the actor sheet (e.g. system.identity.coussinet) and the hiss sound played at the start of the duel. Adjust to match your game system.
